site_area_sqm.formula: polygon_area(submitted provisional site boundary in EPSG:4548)
assumptions: Organizer provisional rough boundary is used for intake/content review only; recalculate when official polygon is supplied.

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: sum(area of six reversible prototype footprints)
assumptions: Illustrative design envelopes, not existing or approved building footprints.

green_ratio.formula: Edgecase Spine area / provisional site area
assumptions: Design ratio only, not statutory green-space control.

public_space_ratio.formula: union(public co-test courts) / provisional site area
assumptions: Design ratio only, not statutory public-space control.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official parcel/building data are absent.

assumptions: Key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry.

edgecase_test_tier_count.formula: count(T1 controlled, T2 community co-test, T3 everyday-open tiers)

edgecase_scenario_count.formula: count(numbered EDGE scenario cards in proposal)
assumptions: Scenario cards are design proposals, not deployed services.
Conceptual links; official road redlines unavailable.

human_override_court_count.formula: count(public co-test courts requiring human override)
assumptions: Operational requirement encoded by proposal, not an existing facility count.
